# Pune Property Expo 2026

> The official portal for the Pune Property Expo 2026 hosted by The Real Estate Mall on August 29th & 30th, 2026.

The Pune Property Expo 2026 brings together 60+ top developers and 200+ residential and commercial projects under one roof across Baner and Kharadi hubs[cite: 3]. It offers attendees spot booking discounts, zero brokerage fees, instant bank loan approvals, and a dedicated Dubai Real Estate investment desk[cite: 3].

## Core Details
- [Event Overview & VIP Registration](https://www.punepropertiesexpo.in/#register): Claim free VIP entry passes, select budget preferences, and reserve event seats.
- [Expo Hubs & Locations](https://www.punepropertiesexpo.in/#hubs): Venue details for Baner Road (West Pune) and Kharadi IT Hub (East Pune).
- [Why Attend](https://www.punepropertiesexpo.in/#why-attend): Overview of exclusive spot discounts, free site cabs, and bank loan sanctioning.

## Event Specifications
- **Dates:** August 29th & 30th, 2026 (10:00 AM – 8:00 PM)
- **Organized By:** The Real Estate Mall (MahaRERA Reg No: A041262500652)
- **Property Price Range:** ₹70 Lakhs to ₹30 Crores (Residential & Commercial)
- **Venues:** 
  - *Baner Hub:* 2/2 Achalare House, Baner Road, Pune 411069
  - *Kharadi Hub:* Nyati Plaza, Thite Nagar, Kharadi, Pune 411014
